product.title: Mt. Fuji & Hakone Tour Tokyo hotel pick-up by Grayline

description.text: In Tokyo, this guided Grayline day uses designated hotel pickup, a national licensed guide-interpreter, and published tickets for the Hakone sky gondola and Lake Ashi cruise. The route aims for the Mount Fuji 5th Station when the Subaru Line is open, then Owakudani Valley and the lake circuit, with weather substitutions listed toward Gotemba, Hakone Shrine, or a Kawaguchi boat. An optional bullet-train return to Tokyo Station is published. Lunch is included only on the with-lunch option. The format suits visitors who want a coordinated Fuji-Hakone coach day without buying gondola and cruise tickets independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Tokyo, and the itinerary stays on the Fifth Station, Owakudani, the Hakone gondola, and Lake Ashi that define this outing rather than a private lake charter.
